title: fix(app-shell): a member refused the Setup app gets the access-denied screen on the Setup create form too
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbLD68mjjNpw7dAnZ7BBKoKi)_

Fixes #29102

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:没有 Setup 应用权限的普通成员打开 Setup 下的新建表单(`/apps/setup/sys_user/new` 这类别名地址)时,现在看到与同一对象列表页相同的「无权访问此应用」页面;规范地址 `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/OBJECT/new` 也是同一页面。
- 为什么改:上一张卡只拦了列表路由,新建表单仍会套着默认应用的顶栏和侧栏显示,地址栏写着 setup,像进了管理后台。
- 风险与回滚:只改界面判定,服务端对每次写入的权限判定不变;管理员不受影响(不发起探测)。审批收件箱链接到的记录页 `/apps/setup/OBJECT/record/ID` 按 objectui#12706 的未决决定保持原样。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`(`OBJECT_COLLECTION_ROUTE_PATHS` 新增的 `:objectName/new` 一行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.setupObjectListVerdict-28988.test.tsx`,预期 16 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- The route set that waits on the Setup app's access verdict under the `setup` alias now includes the create form, `:objectName/new`, beside the list routes #28988 added (`:objectName`, `:objectName/view/:viewId`, `:objectName/data`). A `denied` verdict draws `app-access-denied` and the form never mounts.
- The set and its matcher are renamed for what they now hold, the object routes that name no record: `OBJECT_LIST_ROUTE_PATHS` becomes `OBJECT_COLLECTION_ROUTE_PATHS`, `isObjectListAppRoute` becomes `isObjectCollectionAppRoute`, and `isSetupObjectListRoute` becomes `isSetupObjectCollectionRoute`. Matching is unchanged: by route rank against `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS` plus the host's routes, so a static or host route under the Setup segment is never read as one.
- Record routes (`OBJECT/record/ID`, its `/edit` and `/page/NAME`, and the `OBJECT/ID` shorthand) stay outside the gate, as objectui#12706 leaves them. No metadata key or option is added.

## Why

`/apps/setup` is a pseudo-route, so an unmatched `setup` segment falls back to the launcher's default app unless `appSurfaceAwaitsVerdict` names the sub-route. After #28988 it named the list routes only, so a refused member on `/apps/setup/OBJECT/new` got the create form inside the default app's chrome. The create form names no record, so no approvals-inbox link lands on it. The canonical `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/OBJECT/new` is an ordinary unmatched app and already drew the refusal; it is pinned here so both spellings stay the same.

## Tests

- `AppContent.setupObjectListVerdict-28988.test.tsx` gains a stubbed `RecordFormPage` (counted like the other page stubs) and four cases:
  - A refused caller gets `app-access-denied`, no `ConsoleLayout` and no page mounted, on `/apps/setup/sys_user/new`, `/apps/setup/showcase_task/new` and `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user/new`. The one by-name probe is the app the URL names, and the URL is left as typed.
  - Control: an admitted caller gets the create form (`mode="create"`) under Setup, unprobed.
  - The existing control that a refused caller still opens the record page the approvals inbox links to (`/apps/setup/sys_user/record/usr_000001`) passes unchanged, as do the objectui#12706 file's inbox controls.
- Red on `main`: with `AppContent.tsx` at `c44c8ac4` and the new tests unchanged, the two alias cases fail (Tests 2 failed, 14 passed). The package-id case and the controls pass there.

## Acceptance notes

- The canonical spelling needed no code change; the test pins it so the two spellings cannot drift apart again.
- Record routes under the Setup segment are untouched, per the claim and objectui#12706.
